author: Zechariah
authorNote: Some scholars think chapters 9–14 come from a later prophet.
overview: Zechariah encourages the rebuilding of the temple with a series of night visions. He looks ahead to a humble king "riding on a donkey", which the Gospels see fulfilled on Palm Sunday.
storyPlace: One of the twelve shorter prophetic books known as the Minor Prophets ("minor" because they are short, not less important).
